constraint_results.judge_reason: The implementation satisfies both requirements: (1) It recursively processes nested dictionaries through the _redact helper function, which handles dict values by recursively calling _redact on nested_value and accumulating the count across all nesting levels. It also handles lists recursively. (2) After redaction, it calls auditing.write_event('redaction.applied', keys_redacted=count) with the total count of redacted keys accumulated from all nesting levels.
